title: fix: preserve spaces while typing app search
author: ale-rls
pr_body_excerpt:
- Preserve raw app-search text in controlled input updates and URL validation, so sequential multi-word typing retains spaces.
- Trim only the derived matching query; keep empty-query clearing, filters and navigation options unchanged.
- Add focused URL serialization/validator regressions. Validation: original regression fails; all 70 website tests, declared build (TypeScript/Vite), changed-file Biome and independent component checks pass. Component evidence uses fixture data and a controlled input shell.

Fixes #16484

gist.headline: Spaces get to stay
gist.blurb: App search stops eating the space between words as you type. A small fix for anyone looking for an app with more than one word in its name.
gist.summary: App search preserves raw input and URL text while trimming only the query used for matching, so sequential multi-word typing keeps its spaces without changing empty-query clearing, filters, or navigation.
gist.impact: Users can type multi-word app searches without spaces disappearing between keystrokes.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the pollinations.ai app directory as a cozy garden of app cards. Polli types a two-word query into a retro search terminal; a clearly visible space separates the words, and matching app cards bloom nearby. Give her tiny typing glasses.
